headline: Quitting can no longer cost you work
highlights: \u{2318}Q now pauses on one plain question before anything is lost: with unsaved session changes it offers Save and Quit / Quit Anyway / Cancel, and with a batch or export still running it offers Quit Anyway / Cancel. A clean, idle session quits silently, exactly as before.
\u{2318}W closes the window without ending the app. The session survives untouched — click the Dock icon and the window is back exactly as it was. Closing the window used to quit the whole app.
